ur.title: Zameen khodi to sone ka matka nikla… lekin dono ne lene se inkaar kyun kiya? 🤯
alts: Khazana mila… aur jhagda ye ki 'ye mera nahi, tumhara hai'
Aaj ke zamane mein aisa koi karega? Aakhir tak dekhiye
ur.description:
Ek aadmi ne zameen khareedi… aur khudai mein sone se bhara matka nikal aaya.
Lekin asli hairat to tab hui jab dono kehte rahe: "Ye mera nahi hai!" Faisla kaise hua? Aakhir tak dekhiye.

💬 Aapko ye matka milta to aap kya karte? Sach batana 😄

📖 Reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 3472 · Sahih Muslim 1721

en.title: He dug up a pot of gold… so why did BOTH men refuse it? 🤯
alts: They found treasure… and argued 'it's not mine, it's yours!'
Would anyone do this today? Watch till the end
en.description:
A man bought some land… and while digging, he found a pot full of gold.
But the real surprise came when both men kept saying: "This isn't mine!" How was it settled? Watch till the end.

💬 If you found this pot, what would you do? Be honest 😄

📖 Reference: Sahih al-Bukhari 3472 · Sahih Muslim 1721
🔔 A new Islamic story every week: subscribe.

lines.text: Ek aadmi ne zameen khareedi… lekin khodte waqt use kuch aisa mila, jise dekhkar uski saansein ruk gayin!
lines.voiceText: एक आदमी ने ज़मीन ख़रीदी… लेकिन खोदते वक़्त उसे कुछ ऐसा मिला, जिसे देखकर उसकी साँसें रुक गईं!

en.text: A man bought a piece of land… but while digging, he found something that took his breath away!

lines.text: Matke ke andar… sona hi sona tha!
lines.voiceText: मटके के अंदर… सोना ही सोना था!

en.text: Inside the pot… was gold, nothing but gold!

lines.speaker: kharidar
lines.text: Maine aapse zameen khareedi thi, khazana nahi. Ye sona aapka hai.
lines.voiceText: मैंने आपसे ज़मीन ख़रीदी थी, ख़ज़ाना नहीं। यह सोना आपका है।

en.text: I bought the land from you, not the treasure. This gold is yours.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: Maine tumhe zameen bech di thi. Ab jo kuch usme nikla, wo tumhara hai.
lines.voiceText: मैंने तुम्हें ज़मीन बेच दी थी। अब जो कुछ उसमें निकला, वह तुम्हारा है।

en.text: I sold you the land. Whatever was in it now belongs to you.

lines.text: Dono itne imaandaar the… ki sona rakhne ko koi tayyar hi nahi tha! Aakhir dono ek buzurg ke paas gaye.
lines.voiceText: दोनों इतने ईमानदार थे… कि सोना रखने को कोई तैयार ही नहीं था! आख़िर दोनों एक बुज़ुर्ग के पास गए।

en.text: Both were so honest… that no one was willing to keep the gold! So they went to a wise elder.
And do you have a daughter?

lines.text: Tab faisla hua — ek ke bete aur doosre ki beti ki shaadi kar di jaye… aur khazana unhe de diya jaye.
lines.voiceText: तब फ़ैसला हुआ — एक के बेटे और दूसरे की बेटी की शादी कर दी जाए… और ख़ज़ाना उन्हें दे दिया जाए।

en.text: So it was decided: one man's son would marry the other's daughter… and the treasure would be given to them.
